title: Cloud cost limits
description: An optional daily and monthly limit of what cloud models may cost, in US dollars: once one is reached, each new cloud request is held until you raise it (or the day or month ends). Days and months are this computer's.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The kind and version this file is written in; always its first field.

title.description: The name clients show for this record; the file's own name when empty.
title.title: Title

day_usd.description: What the cloud may cost in a day, in US dollars; empty: no limit.
day_usd.title: Daily limit

month_usd.description: What the cloud may cost in a month, in US dollars; empty: no limit.
month_usd.title: Monthly limit

warn_at.description: The share of a limit at which you are told once, such as 0.8.
warn_at.title: Warn at
